notes: The built-in print presets from v0.5.4 are now the defaults: the Print Label modal opens directly on the 40x20 mm Vertical Price barcode label (or Shelf Price when opened from a shelf-tag action), sale receipts default to the 80 mm Professional template, and the label preview starts at real size (zoom 1x). Most importantly, the sticker barcode is now actually scanner-readable: bar modules print at a fixed physical width (0.216 mm on the 40x20 label, ~1.75x wider than before, comfortably above the 0.19 mm scanner floor) using the full label width, and the receipt invoice barcode prints at 0.3 mm per module — no more silent shrink-to-fit that made bars too thin for barcode readers.
